modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Interpret information from various views, projection, 2D and 3D shapes

pcs.pc_description: interpret engineering drawing's uniqueness, dimensions and important features in 2D and 3D shapes
identify the difference between 2D and 3D shapes
explain difference between first angle projection and third angle projection in mechanical engineering drawing
interpret all the 3 axes (x, y and z axis) and geometrical shapes (cones, cylinder, sphere, cuboid, etc) on to a 2D and 3D projection
identify details of the machine component which are not clearly visible by interpreting section views
interpret Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerencing (GD&T) symbols in the drawings

interpret symbols of Radius, controlled radius, spherical radius, diameter, spherical diameter, square, counterbore, spotface, depth, countersink, “by”, maximum dimension, minimum dimension, reference, dimension origin etc
identify the sequence of operations which enables the selection and prioritization of the datums
read and interpret information from Tolerance Zone boundaries for part features in terms of shape and size
observe any modification, changes required in the drawing and communicate the same to the concerned team in the organization
store the drawings in an easily accessible place, avoiding damage from moisture, chemicals and fire

pcs.pc_description: identify product requirements such as customer preferences, benchmarking data, technology parameters etc. received from the Cross Functional Team (CFT)
analyse the type of component (including new component), technology and technique to be used in design of the product
analyse the parameters such as road scenarios, vehicle aesthetic appeal & ergonomics, shape/ size/ environmental impact etc. for design of the product
identify and select simulation tools such as CAD, CAM etc. as per the SOP and job requirements

modules.module_title: Support line manager in finalization of design specifications

pcs.pc_description: support the line manager in creating specifications for design input and requirements of each of the aggregates, circuits, ECU programming, etc.
support in deciding the means for providing design input and requirements of each of the aggregates, circuits, ECU programming, etc.
support in creating a mechanism for capturing design output
ensure that all the required design specifications are achieved and there is conformance between output and input of the design

modules.module_title: Ensure reliability and validity of the product design

pcs.pc_description: identify reliability requirements on the basis of benchmarks, competitive analysis, cost, safety, etc. with the support on the manager
prioritize key reliability risk items and the corresponding risk reduction strategy with the help of the product design manager
estimate the products design reliability and analyse it by using simulation models, prior warranty and tests data from similar models
analyse failure risks and mechanics of the product design
use design of experiments methodology to identify factors significant to the life of the vehicle
use Life Data Analysis (LDA) techniques to statistically estimate the reliability of the product design and calculate various reliability-related metrics
conduct Reliability Growth (RG) testing and analyse effective methodology to discover defects and improve the design during/ post testing inputs

modules.module_title: Design the vehicle/components using simulation tools

pcs.pc_description: transform the functional architecture of vehicle design to physical architecture with the support of line manager
create EV product designs as per the defined geometrical parameters which can be readily altered by changing relevant parameters
use organisation recommended simulation tools, software and applications to perform designing
build a simulated model of the EV design as per the engineering inputs, customer requirements and product necessities
analyse suspension and structural strength, correct tolerance limits of electronic components etc. of the design
analyse the model using different loads to check and validate the design
incorporate smaller circuits like clippers, clampers, current/ voltage boosters, signal conditioner circuits, etc. in the design
incorporate different sensors and actuators to monitor the different electronic parameters in the design
use BMS software validation and simulation along with battery points like basic, runtime, impedance, 1st principle modelling
support line manager to create and validate the standardized Work Analysis Sheet to see the same basic processes are used in the simulation
create failure modes in the simulation model to identify all possible failure scenarios
identify the potential root causes and consequence of each failure mode
create a rating system (0 to 10) to identify the seriousness of each cause
identify current process controls that are applicable, controls that can be established and detection rating (DR) for each cause
identify and implement recommended actions (design changes) to lower the severity or occurrence of each cause

modules.module_title: Perform simulations on the product design

pcs.pc_description: formulate simulation model to check the architectural design with the support of line manager
run the simulation to test the model
analyse results of test by comparing behaviour with the actual environment and then make changes accordingly in the model
validate simulation by increasing the chances that the model will be valid in the real world like crash simulation, chassis, power steering, battery pack, etc.
create a standardized work combination sheet to see the processes used, work sequence order and changes done after failure analysis in the simulation

modules.module_title: Complete process pertaining to telematics and human machine interface for product design

pcs.pc_description: validate that telematics system can analyse drivers sense of driving and follows the design requirements

use high performance HMI (Human Machine Interface) to achieve specific performance and goal objectives/targets for process control such as safety parameters, production rate, efficiency, cost, and quality
analyse controls that must be monitored and manipulated to achieve the performance and goal objectives
design high performance graphics by following the HMI and addressing the identified tasks
install, commission and provide training on the new HMI
control, maintain and periodically re-assess the HMI performance
collect information regarding the product design, product structure management, product material, process management of the product etc.
maintain and store the information and records regarding product development and tools to be used as per SOP
maintain the data related to history, present use, serialization, part status, customer preference etc. related to the product as per SOP
ensure planning and control of the entire system though status control reports, meetings reviews, etc.
ensure continued system integration and validation of the data captured
